thread:
Lina: Thanks everyone for joining the all-hands — appreciate the questions. Quick follow-up with clarifications, links, and owners. I’ll ping folks for direct handoffs.

Tom: Can you confirm the Dedicated GA window? A customer asked about committing next quarter.

Lina: Short answer: aiming for mid-June as our public GA target, but that date is still soft until we finish the last perf sweep and SLA signoff. Enterprise pilots can be configured earlier (reach out to sales-eng).

Anu: Where are we on runtime quantization guidance? Need to prep a migration playbook for customers using float16.

Lina: We have a draft in the eng-runtime repo + a short explainer in the docs. Link: https://redwood.ai/docs/quantization-guide (internal). Action: @Anu will own a 1-pager migration playbook and checklist by 2024-05-10.

Raj: For routing/fallbacks — is there a recommended policy to prioritize latency over cost for paid tiers?

Lina: Yes — default routing policy for enterprise tier will be `latency-first`. We’ll add a toggle in the Console to switch to `cost-aware` for non-critical routes. Action: @Raj to draft console text and safe-fallback examples by next Wed.

Maya: Any updates on Private (VPC) compliance posture? A banking pilot asked about encryption-at-rest and audit logs.

Lina: We support customer-managed KMS/HSM for Private now. SOC2 readiness is on the roadmap — ETA end of Q3. For the pilot, share the architecture diagram: https://redwood.ai/internal/private-arch.png and cc security-eng. Action: @Maya to collate pilot checklist and legal FAQ with security by 2024-05-06.

Tom: Is there a short FAQ I can send to the sales rep?

Lina: Yes — Sales FAQ draft: https://redwood.ai/internal/sales-faq (internal). Please add any missing Qs inline.

deploy-bot: Recording uploaded: https://drive.redwood.ai/all-hands/2034567890 (permissions: all-hands viewers).

Lina: Two quick product clarifications from Q&A: 1) Redwood Optimize recommendations will include model + quantization suggestions by workload starting in the next beta. 2) Console will show token-level cost breakdown for canaries before GA.

Anu: Noted, will sync with research on evals for quantization regressions.

Lina: ACTION ITEMS (owners):
- @Anu: 1-pager migration playbook for quantized runtimes — due 2024-05-10.
- @Raj: Console copy & fallback examples for routing policies — due 2024-05-08.
- @Maya: Private pilot checklist & security FAQ for banking pilot — due 2024-05-06.
- Product/Docs: Publish Sales FAQ and link to recording — assigned to Lina, due 2024-05-03.

Tom: Thanks — I’ll forward the FAQ to the rep once it lands. :thumbsup:

Lina: Great. If anyone else has follow-ups not covered here drop them in this thread or ping me directly. I’ll update the shared action tracker by tomorrow.
